dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thanks for waiting. Next question: do you prefer shopping online or in stores?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks fər ˈweɪtɪŋ. ˈnɛkst ˈkwɛstʃən: duː juː prɪˈfɜːr ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ɔːr ɪn ˈstɔːrz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Usually, I prefer shopping online to going to the mall.
dialogue.reading: ˈjuːʒuəli, aɪ prɪˈfɜːr ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn tə ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈmɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Convenience, mainly. I can browse a hundred shops from my bed!
dialogue.reading: kənˈviːniəns, ˈmeɪnli. aɪ kən ˈbraʊz ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈʃɑːps frəm maɪ ˈbɛd!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is there anything you prefer to buy in person?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ juː prɪˈfɜːr tə ˈbaɪ ɪn ˈpɜːrsən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Shoes. I prefer trying them on in a physical store. Sizes online aren't always right.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃuːz. aɪ prɪˈfɜːr ˈtraɪɪŋ ðɛm ˈɑːn ɪn ə ˈfɪzɪkəl ˈstɔːr. ˈsaɪzɪz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈɑːrənt ˈɔːlweɪz ˈraɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈɛvər ˈɡoʊ ˈwɪndoʊ ˌʃɑːpɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes, with my friends. We look at everything but buy nothing!
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz, wɪð maɪ ˈfrɛndz. wiː ˈlʊk ət ˈɛvriθɪŋ bʌt ˈbaɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, do you prefer online stores to physical stores for most things?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, duː juː prɪˈfɜːr ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈstɔːrz tə ˈfɪzɪkəl ˈstɔːrz fər ˈmoʊst ˈθɪŋz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: For most things, yes. But I prefer the mall to my phone when I want to relax with friends.
dialogue.reading: fər ˈmoʊst ˈθɪŋz, ˈjɛs. bʌt aɪ prɪˈfɜːr ðə ˈmɔːl tə maɪ ˈfoʊn wɛn aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə rɪˈlæks wɪð ˈfrɛndz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. Many young people say the same.
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. ˈmɛni ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ðə ˈseɪm.
